description: This file contains unit tests for the ValidationUniqueDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods that verify the uniqueness of various field values (such as employee ID, username, email) against the database, using PHPUnit testing framework. The class sets up test data and runs assertions to ensure the DAO behaves correctly under different scenarios.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the ValidationUniqueDao methods for checking value uniqueness in the database.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ValidationUniqueDao, setting up fixture data file path, and populating test data.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests that the isValueUnique method correctly identifies duplicate employee IDs.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForSystemUser
methods.description: Tests that the isValueUnique method correctly handles username uniqueness, including active and deleted users.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests the email uniqueness validation, considering email notification status and user state.
